description: This file defines the ConvertLeadUI class, which manages the user interface logic for converting leads in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving lead details, checking module activity, and managing ownership and field info.

classes.name: ConvertLeadUI
classes.description: Class to manage UI-related operations for lead conversion in vtiger CRM, including lead info retrieval, permission checks, and owner assignment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with lead ID and current user, fetching lead details from the database.

methods.name: isModuleActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific module is active and permitted for editing.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific field in a module is active and visible.

methods.name: isMandatory
methods.description: Determines if a field in a module is mandatory.

methods.name: getFieldInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information for a specific field in a module.

methods.name: setAssignedToInfo
methods.description: Sets information about the owner (user or group) assigned to the lead.

methods.name: getUserSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the user is selected as owner.

methods.name: getUserDisplay
methods.description: Returns display status for user owner selection.

methods.name: getGroupSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the group is selected as owner.

methods.name: getGroupDisplay
methods.description: Returns display status for group owner selection.

methods.name: getLeadInfo
methods.description: Returns the lead details fetched from the database.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the date format of the current user.

methods.name: getleadId
methods.description: Returns the lead ID.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the lead, properly encoded.

methods.name: getIndustryList
methods.description: Retrieves list of industry picklist values.

methods.name: getSalesStageList
methods.description: Retrieves list of sales stage picklist values.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the current user's ID.

methods.name: getOwnerList
methods.description: Forms a list of owner options (users or groups) with selection status.

methods.name: checkOwnership
methods.description: Checks sharing privileges to determine if ownership is private.

methods.name: getMappedFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves mapped field value for lead conversion, considering picklist types.
